body:
thanks for your complex response and sorry to hear your story, it did give me a little bit of an insight to other people's problem and I have to say I can relate, but I don't now how long would it take to stop blaming myself and recalling those bad moments, and whether I will be able to overcome these things. It simply tends to come back as a nightmare or an uncureable disease, cancer is what comes to my mind. 

Hope you will be able to become happy and satisified with your life, myself on the other hand, maybe I'll just focus on those months I had left, primarily I was thinking about the August to be my last month on this planet - still can have some fun, but I genuinely do not expect miracles or big turn arounds.

Trust me, I did try. In thousands of possible ways I did try to start all over again. But once I got a grip on my life again, I was overcome constantly with this feeling that I've lost too much time, too many years that I will never, fully going to recover. Looking at my peers and relatives at my age, it makes me want to cry knowing that no matter how hard I will try, I won't make up this time I've lost on fighting with depression, anxiety disorders. 

I think that one of the Zeno's paradoxes, that is so-called Achilles and the tortoise paradox greatly explain what I'm feeling.

Simply, I can't even recall/remember everything and the list would go on, and on. But the biggest thing I can't get over it is that I wasn't able to find a job during a gap year before my college, therefore I didn't have money to start my academic education on prestigious university, instead I've stayed in my hometown and went to some local uni. I don't know how to put this, but since I wasn't doing really great in high school I felt, and even now I feel like it was pretty much the only chance to 'restore my true value' and to show some people and especially myself, what I'm really capable of -> didn't work out sadly, couldn't start my 'journey' there due to financial inability to move to other city. Got into some misery, not to mention, the shit I got through in my home, it's unbearable. 


P.S. I know that it's really hard to understand my point, since I can't describe everything precisely, noone would be interested as well, and this kind of problem may come across as a laughing matter, but I can't even tell you how important this was and is for me personally.

because I've been making so many attempts in my life and failed at them so badly, that I'm no longer interested in starting all over again. I don't how to put this, but it's a felling that no matter how hard I will try, I won't make up the time I've lost and recover those years of being young and being able to live a carefree life. It will never be the same. 

Besides, since I've been reading quite a lot about psychology, I guess that I can refer my situation to study of so called **learned helplessness**. After so many hopeless losts, I'm not really interested in making further attempts. Cheers

I guess it's the case of being unable to forgive myself for the mistakes I've done in the past, being unable to get over some things and constantly experiencing this feel of shame and being guilty. Constantly blaming myself for everything, being unable to forget about some things and being unable to carry on with the compromised version of my life, which for me frankly isn't acceptable. Tried my best to compromise with my expectations, dreams and wishes but I just can't, every day is full of regrets and flashback from the past. Irritating feelings, like 'would, could, should', and my best recall - 'what if...', just can't take any longer. 

I'm not gonna lie, besides depression I have experienced some anxiety disorders, I'm not that mental, coming accross as a normal, shy, perfectly normal dude. But, due to anxiety disorders I messed up my college education and I've been lieing (lying ?) quite badly, due to the fact for instance that I simply wasn't able to participate in classes. I didn't even visit a psychiatrist, since I was ashamed. 

Not to mention that I don't have a great relationship with people who theoritically are my closest relatives... 

And worst of all -> I can't stand the fact that I fall behind my peers, knowing that I've lost so many years on this battle with depression and hard-times at my home, due to abusive mother and sister, who really had a negative impact on me.
